integrity: The full-state identity is proved by exact finite-generator moments and Walsh inversion; fixed-parameter computation only cross-checks it. Originality is explicitly restricted to the heterogeneous multibath result.
scientific_limitations: Finite star with independently refreshed infinite-temperature hub; no hub feedback, leaf-leaf bonds or correlated update clocks.
Full multibath law allows independent leaf rates; the beta mixture specifically assumes equal leaf update rates.
Prior results already imply a restricted uniform-noise voter subfamily and establish the classical beta filter law.
Historical priority in general switching-process literature is not exhaustive; no thermodynamic phase transition is asserted.
title: Exact multibath stationary law and decoupled heat currents on an Ising star
